interpretation: The profile intervention changes landscape behavior and improves the shared-stop calibration objective at r=0,0.5,1,2,4, but not at r=8. It does not improve the intrinsic objective at any ratio; independent-difference improves only at r=4 and r=8.

At inherited r=0.5 shared-stop, the fresh-seed median walk length and pooled high-order fraction move close to the empirical targets, while equal-cube epistasis, sign epistasis, median DR, and top-1% success medians move farther away.

Closer ensemble medians do not imply more reliable individual realizations: only 2/8 paired fresh seeds improve walk-length absolute error and 4/8 improve pooled-high-order error. Ranges broaden materially. No across-metric or across-seed general superiority is supported.
The reused cohort also shows mixed effects, so the primary pattern does not support a seed-robust general advantage.
At high interaction ratios the profile shared-stop equal-cube spectra and DR move toward empirical values while walks shorten and top-1% success remains high. No new optimal ratio is selected.

Noiseless profile top-1% success remains roughly 0.95 to 1 across ratios; shared-stop assumptions remain important to the apparent joint agreement. At r=0 shared-stop already induces large observed epistasis, so necessity of latent interactions is not established.
limitations: Finite original optimization budget was retained; all fits report nonconvergence at the iteration cap. Objective differences do not establish globally optimal fit or model-capacity dominance.

This is one four-site TrpB system and one author frequency profile, rounded to 0.001, with 0.01 uniform probability mixture. The deposited raw alignment is unusable and sequence weighting/N_eff are unknown.

The intervention preserves seed-specific computational references, global mutation-RMS normalization and procedural GNK interactions. It tests this concrete profile implementation, not every possible conservation prior or biological reference policy.

Held confirmation cube geometry is retained, but empirical data were inspected previously; fresh seeds are generator variation, not independent biological replication. Whole-library graph calculations include calibration nodes.
Observation models are fixed sensitivity assumptions, not identified intrinsic biology. Pooled and equal-cube WHT summaries answer different questions and both must remain visible.
No sequence-specific fitness prediction, empirical epistatic interaction recovery, PLM calibration, ML ranking transfer, arbitrary-length biological realism or package acceptance criterion is tested.

methods.DR: slope_median is the within-seed median across eligible fixed-direction mutation slopes; slope is an equal-cube average of cube-mean slopes. These estimands are not interchangeable.
methods.WHT: epistatic_fraction and ho_fraction average eligible per-cube fractions equally; pooled fractions sum powers before taking ratios, within each seed. Then seed quantiles are computed.
methods.fitted: Calibration fitness quantiles, mean local SD and near-floor mass. Confirmation SD/floor are retained confirmation evaluations of fitted descriptors.
methods.input: Read-only analysis of frozen outputs; no calibration or control reruns.
methods.paired_error: abs(profile - common empirical target) - abs(synthetic - common empirical target), separately for each metric and identical seed. Negative means closer. No normalization, aggregation, weights or acceptance threshold.

primary_setting.selection: Inherited illustrative setting from CLAIM-004/RUN-175; not selected using RUN-178 results.

methods.quantiles: pandas quantile default linear interpolation; 10th/median/90th across seeds; generator variation, not confidence intervals
methods.ties: Primary counts use strict <0 / >0 and exact ==0. Separate abs(delta)<=1e-10 counts flag numerical ties only; no scientific decision threshold.
methods.unfitted: WHT fractions, DR slopes, sign epistasis and whole-library graph/adaptive-walk statistics do not enter the fitting objective.
